WITH client_by_region AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(client_count) as total_clients,
    CAST(1 AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM client_by_region
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cbr.client_count,
    CAST(cbr.client_count AS REAL) / s.total_clients as share,
    s.avg_share
  FROM client_by_region cbr, stats s
)
SELECT 
  SUM(client_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_distance_above_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
